title: Rehoboam Strengthens Judah

questions.question: How many warriors did Rehoboam assemble to fight against Israel?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 11:1 (ESV): "...he assembled the house of Judah and Benjamin, 180,000 chosen warriors..."

questions.question: Who did the word of the LORD come to, forbidding the fight?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 11:2 (ESV): "But the word of the LORD came to Shemaiah the man of God..."

questions.question: Why did God say they should not fight?
options: For this thing is from Me
questions.correctAnswer: For this thing is from Me
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 11:4 (ESV): "...for this thing is from me."

questions.question: Which cities did Rehoboam build for defense?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 11:6 (ESV): "He built Bethlehem, Etam, Tekoa..." (and list follows)

questions.question: Who resorted to Rehoboam from all Israel?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 11:13 (ESV): "And the priests and the Levites who were in all Israel presented themselves to him..."

questions.question: Why did the Levites leave their common lands?
options: Because Jeroboam and his sons cast them out
questions.correctAnswer: Because Jeroboam and his sons cast them out
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 11:14 (ESV): "...because Jeroboam and his sons cast them out from serving as priests of the LORD..."

questions.question: What did Jeroboam appoint for himself?
options: Priests for the high places and for the goat idols and for the calves
questions.correctAnswer: Priests for the high places and for the goat idols and for the calves
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 11:15 (ESV): "...and he appointed his own priests for the high places and for the goat idols and for the calves that he had made."

questions.question: How long did they walk in the way of David and Solomon?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 11:17 (ESV): "...for they walked for three years in the way of David and Solomon."

questions.question: Who was Rehoboam's favorite wife?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 11:21 (ESV): "Rehoboam loved Maacah the daughter of Absalom above all his wives and concubines..."

questions.question: Which son did Rehoboam appoint as chief prince?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 11:22 (ESV): "Rehoboam appointed Abijah the son of Maacah as chief prince among his brothers..."

questions.question: How many wives and concubines did Rehoboam take?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 11:21 (ESV): "...he took eighteen wives and sixty concubines..."

questions.question: How many sons and daughters did Rehoboam have?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 11:21 (ESV): "...and fathered twenty-eight sons and sixty daughters."

questions.question: Who was Mahalath the daughter of?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 11:18 (ESV): "Rehoboam took as wife Mahalath the daughter of Jerimoth the son of David..."

questions.question: What did Rehoboam do wisely regarding his sons?
options: He distributed them throughout all the lands of Judah and Benjamin
questions.correctAnswer: He distributed them throughout all the lands of Judah and Benjamin
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 11:23 (ESV): "He dealt wisely and distributed some of his sons through all the districts of Judah and Benjamin..."

questions.question: What did Rehoboam intend to do with Abijah?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 11:22 (ESV): "...for he intended to make him king."

key_verse_text: Thus says the LORD: You shall not go up or fight against your relatives. Return every man to his home, for this thing is from me. So they listened to the word of the LORD and returned and did not go against Jeroboam.
